about.text: The cheese is ready after an average of 60 to 66 days in a controlled environment. The flavor is full, and in older cheeses the taste is slightly piquant. The largest producer is Mljekara Livno or Lura Dairy d.o.o. Livno, with yearly production exceeding 500 metric tons.

facts.v: Also in Kupres, Glamoč and Tomislavgrad, not only around Livno
Made since the 19th century on family farms, by a Gruyère-type method
